Segnala offerta di lavoro Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation, and growth drives everything we do. Our Integrated Marketing team’s mission is to turn central marketing direction, Italy business priorities, and consumer insights into an integrated 360° marketing plan, then bring local and central teams together to coordinate delivery and measure effectiveness. Success Looks Like One integrated 360° Italy marketing plan aligned with business priorities Data-driven recommendations and trade-off decisions Aligned local and central teams, with risks anticipated Campaigns delivered and measured against clear KPIs Clear leadership visibility on priorities, risks and results We’re looking for an Integrated Marketing Manager to join our Milan team. This is a hybrid role and you’ll help us on Marketing Planning, Orchestrating 360° Campaigns, Tracking Performance. What You’ll Be Doing You'll join the Integrated Marketing Italy team with a primary focus on planning and strategy: you'll be the go-to person for turning central direction, business objectives and market insight into a clear, prioritised, data-driven 360° plan. Here’s What Your Day-to-day Might Look Like Own integrated marketing planning: Lead quarterly and annual planning for the Italian market, (from kick-off through approval of priorities, objectives, budgets and calendar), translating central direction and local insight into one coherent plan and shared marketing calendar Bring data into the plan: synthesise performance, business insight and customer/market intelligence (partnering with Finance, Business Strategy and Insights teams) to inform priorities and support the team's assumptions Steer marketing calendar: keep the shared marketing calendar as the single source of truth, ensuring every initiative ties back to strategy and objectives and act as operational gatekeeper Drive tracking and governance: Monitor deliverables against objectives, maintain campaign documentation, consolidate visibility over marketing investment, and run post-campaign reviews that turn learnings into insights Lead through influence: Work across multiple functional teams, arbitrating competing local and central priorities across marketing initiatives. What You’ll Need To Thrive Our ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in some of these areas and curiosity to grow in others: Strategic thinking and business orientation: Intellectual curiosity and the ability to quickly grasp complex topics, connecting marketing choices to market priorities and objectives Data fluency and analytical rigour: Strong ability to interpret performance, challenge assumptions, and turn data into clear recommendations Integrated marketing planning and programme management: Proven experience setting priorities and orchestrating 360° campaign execution end-to-end Stakeholder management and influence: Ability to operate in a matrix environment, simplify complex topics, and communicate effectively with senior stakeholders Prioritisation and operational rigour: Strong trade-off decision-making, risk anticipation, and dependency management. Why Join Us? At Deliveroo, You’ll Do Work That Matters, Solving Real-world Problems In a Three-sided Marketplace That’s Constantly Evolving. We’re Food Lovers, Problem Solvers, Community Builders And More, Brought Together By a Shared Drive To Make Things Better. Working Here You Can Expect To 🔧 Make a visible impact every day Your work directly improves experiences for customers, partners and riders. 🌱 Learn fast in an entrepreneurial environment Work close to the market with autonomy, pace and real responsibility. 🧠 Build a career, not just a role Stretch yourself, develop new skills and grow as the business evolves. 🌎 Deliver together in an inclusive culture Collaborative, values-driven teams that support how you work best. We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine - our interview typically includes 3-4 stages. Find more about how we hire here. Our Global Structure Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team. Compensation National Collective Agreement (CBA): CCNL Commercio e Terziario Classification Level: Livello 2 The salary range for this role is €45,600 – €57,000 gross per year. The successful candidate's starting pay will fall within the pay range listed above and is determined based on a number of job-related factors including, but not limited to, skills, experience, qualifications, work location, and market conditions. This position is not eligible for consideration for an equity/RSU grant. To learn more about our benefits, please do not hesitate to bring this up with your Talent Acquisition Partner! Diversity, Equity and Inclusion At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong. We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief. If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you’ll have the opportunity to let us know once you’ve submitted your application. We’ll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience. If you’re excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we’d love to hear from you! Invia un messaggio diretto all’autore dell’offerta di lavoro da Pronto Visite Pierluigi Morreale Pierluigi Morreale -- 🚀 Cerco Co-Founder (COO / Growth Lead) per scalare ProntoVisite | HealthTech & AI Sono un medico cardiologo e ho ideato, finanziato e sviluppato ProntoVisite : un marketplace sanitario che mette a confronto sanità pubblica e privata, integrato con una suite B2B basata su IA per l'ottimizzazione delle agende e la tutela medico-legale dei professionisti. 🔥 Dove siamo oggi: MVP Validato & Operativo : Piattaforma già attiva sul mercato, con prime cliniche affiliate e prenotazioni reali gestite. Accelerazione PATIC : Selezionati e attualmente inseriti nel programma di accelerazione PATIC (partner Zest). Open Innovation Health : In ingresso imminente in un secondo programma di accelerazione verticale dedicato al settore Salute / Open Innovation. Pre-Seed Ready : In preparazione per il primo round di finanziamento per la scalabilità nazionale. Ora è il momento di accelerare e strutturare la crescita B2B. Cerco un Co-Founder operativo (COO / Growth Lead) che prenda in mano l'execution commerciale e le operation a tempo pieno. Di cosa ti occuperai: B2B Sales & Onboarding : Acquisizione e convenzionamento diretto di cliniche, centri medici e liberi professionisti sul territorio. Go-To-Market & Growth : Definizione ed esecuzione delle strategie di crescita B2B, marketing e partnership strategiche. Operations : Gestione della macchina operativa quotidiana e del funnel di conversione. Fundraising : Collaborazione attiva nella preparazione delle metriche e del pitch per investitori e acceleratori. Chi cerco: Solida esperienza in Business Development B2B, Sales o Growth Hacking (preferibilmente in ambito B2B / Marketplace / SaaS / HealthTech). Attitudine fortemente esecutiva ("hands-on mentality"): fame imprenditoriale, capacità di negoziazione e presenza sul campo. Ambizione di guidare lo scaling di una startup ad alto impatto. Cosa offro: Equity di rilievo : Quota societaria significativa regolata da piano di vesting meritocratico. Validazione & Ecosistema : Entri in una realtà con MVP attivo, trazione iniziale e già inserita in importanti percorsi di accelerazione e Open Innovation. Domain Authority : Esperienza clinica e stabilità del Founder a totale supporto della visione di business. Autonomia totale : Massima fiducia nell'impostare la strategia commerciale e le operation. 📩 Se vuoi costruire da protagonista il futuro della digital health in Italia, scrivimi in privato o candidati direttamente. Segnala offerta di lavoro Job Description Shape customer engagement strategies that turn insights into memorable experiences and measurable business growth. Join us in Genoa as Casino Customer Marketing Manager and play a pivotal role in shaping the future of Casino customer engagement at Costa. You will lead the orchestration of strategic marketing initiatives that connect customer insights, commercial objectives, and memorable guest experiences. Partnering with international stakeholders across Carnival Global Gaming and Costa's commercial ecosystem, you will bring campaigns to life that strengthen customer loyalty, unlock revenue opportunities, and deliver measurable business impact at scale. Live your ambition. Lead with impact You will play a key role in driving Costa’s Casino customer engagement strategy, ensuring that marketing initiatives are transformed into impactful customer experiences and sustainable commercial results. Working at the intersection of Customer Marketing, CRM, Commercial Planning, and Global Gaming, you will connect strategy and execution, bringing together people, processes, data, and technology to deliver high-performing campaigns across the customer lifecycle. Casino Customer Marketing Strategy & Campaign Orchestration You will lead the planning and activation of Casino promotional campaigns, translating commercial priorities into compelling customer engagement initiatives. Acting as the key connector between Carnival Global Gaming and Costa’s commercial and marketing functions, you will ensure that campaigns, offers, targeting strategies, and customer journeys are aligned, commercially effective, and ready for execution. Customer Segmentation, Offer Governance & Customer Value Creation You will define audience and engagement strategies leveraging customer insights, behavioral data, and CRM capabilities. You will oversee the governance of promotional mechanics, discounts, vouchers, and campaign eligibility criteria, ensuring every initiative delivers relevant customer experiences while maximizing business performance and campaign effectiveness. Cross-Functional Leadership, Execution Excellence & Performance Optimization You will coordinate a diverse ecosystem of stakeholders across Marketing, Revenue Management, Sales Channels, IT, CRM, and external partners to ensure seamless delivery of customer marketing initiatives. You will monitor campaign performance, identify optimization opportunities, and continuously improve processes, targeting approaches, and engagement strategies to drive customer loyalty and commercial growth. What Makes You Unique 5–10 years of experience in Customer Marketing, CRM, Loyalty, Customer Engagement, or Commercial Planning roles, with a proven track record of delivering customer-focused commercial initiatives. Strong understanding of customer lifecycle marketing, promotional campaign management, audience segmentation, loyalty programs, and data-driven engagement strategies. Proven ability to navigate complex organizations and successfully align multiple stakeholders across commercial, marketing, operational, and technology functions. Strong analytical mindset with the ability to leverage customer insights and campaign performance data to generate actionable recommendations and measurable improvements. Experience working in CRM and Marketing Automation environments with a solid understanding of campaign governance, execution processes, and customer activation frameworks. Excellent communication, influencing, project management, and stakeholder engagement skills, combined with fluency in English and a collaborative, results-oriented mindset. Availability to travel frequently What We Offer Your Journey with Us At Costa, we make your onboarding experience smooth and welcoming, with flexible smart working policy. Benefits That Matter Enjoy daily meal vouchers, exclusive discounts, and access to our Wellbeing@Costa platform for sports, travel, and cultural perks. We also provide free medical insurance and additional welfare benefits for you and your family. Lifestyle & Family Care Celebrate life’s milestones with special gifts, enjoy discounts on cruises and onboard services, and benefit from convenient solutions like Amazon Hub Lockers in our Genoa offices. Growth & Engagement We invest in your development through tailored learning programs, volunteering opportunities, and wellbeing initiatives. Our loyalty program and community events make Costa not just a workplace but a place to belong. Your employment: Open-term, full-time, hybrid. CCNL: "Contratto Unico dell'Industria armatoriale - Sezione 15 per il personale di Terra". Salary Range: 50.000 - 55.000€ based on skills and professional experience and individual incentive scheme. Who We Are: Our community brings together individuals from different parts of the world, fostering connections and collaboration across cultures, enriched by different perspectives and experiences. We are here to bring happiness and provide unforgettable memories and experiences to our guests. Costa belongs to the Carnival Corporation & plc Group, the largest cruise company in the world. We are the only Italian cruise company flying the Italian flag, sailing the world’s seas for more than 75 years, offering our guests a unique experience on board and on land. We are united by a shared passion: to drive success and live our ambition. Whether on board or shoreside, we bring energy, creativity, and a spirit of adventure to everything we do. Start your journey with us During the interview, all stages of the selection process will be explained to you. If you want to learn more, visit the following website: https://career.costacrociere.it/shoreside/#journey Costa is like a world within a world. Onboard and ashore, we are committed to providing equal opportunities to all, regardless of gender, ethnicity, belief, disability, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic that makes us unique. Every individual is valued and respected for who they are.
